F1.epistemic_lesson: Database non-recall was once again read as non-existence — the exact error mode this whole correction pass exists to eliminate, and here in its worst form: it produced a positive false claim ('this paper is a conflation') rather than merely a missing record. Non-recall of a Chinese-language record by the international indexes queried here is an expected coverage gap, not evidence.

three_distinct_works.authors: Yushuang Liu; Yan Zhao; Falin Wu
three_distinct_works.venue: Journal of Beijing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics (北京航空航天大学学报), 43(3): 497-505
three_distinct_works.role: THE A1 PAPER. Verified via the official journal page, outside this run's database queries. Not returned by OpenAlex or by Crossref in this controlled search. No database ID was obtained in this run and NONE WAS FABRICATED; see `verified_external_records`.

F1.conclusion: bounded bearing-only + set-membership + ellipsoidal outer-bounding is an existing research line represented by three related but DISTINCT works (2014 PLANS, 2016 generic UBB, 2017 bearing-only journal). The brief's substantive claim was correct as written. Paper A2 is also confirmed verbatim in two independent databases.

F2.issue: Round 1 claimed feasible-region diameter does not exist as a localization accuracy metric.
F2.resolution: OVERTURNED. Set-size scalars in a worst-case / bounded-error sense are an established metric family.

evidence.note: Isler & Bajcsy 2006: measurement uncertainty IS the area of the intersection of polygonal convex measurement subsets.
CLOSURE (RSS 2024): explicitly computes the minimum enclosing geodesic ball, defined as the point estimate with minimum WORST-CASE ERROR BOUND, over a bounded-noise feasible set.
Liu & Zhao 2014: uses the ellipsoid's generalization radius as the optimality criterion.
InZSMF 2025: reports average interval area of the zonotopic estimate as a performance metric.
Liu/Zhao/Wu 2016: minimises feasible-set size under UBB disturbances.

F3.issue: Round 1 claimed no planning work handles an unknown target count under bounded error.
F3.resolution: OVERTURNED. A coherent line exists, from the Kieffer / Piet-Lahanier group.

evidence.note: CDC 2018. Set-membership search+track of an a priori UNKNOWN number of targets; maintains a set containing the states of targets still to be discovered; control input chosen to minimise estimation uncertainty at the next time step. Open-access HAL copy.
IFAC 2019. Defines an explicit criterion over detected AND still-to-be-detected targets, used to drive trajectories.
IEEE T-RO 2023. Bounded-error distributed set-membership estimator + MPC to reduce estimation uncertainty.
CDC 2020. Same architecture with decoys and obstacles.

F4.issue: Round 1 represented problem 1 as a set-membership problem needing ellipsoid/zonotope machinery, and called the polygon-intersection route 'novel'.
F4.resolution: The polygon-intersection route is NOT novel as a framework — it is the standard bounded-uncertainty sensing model. Isler & Bajcsy 2006 formalise exactly this: convex polygonal measurement subsets merged by intersection, with a selection algorithm and a 2-approximation guarantee. Our contribution is therefore the APPLICATION (bearing sectors from 示向度 with a hard ±1 deg bound, and the specific question 1 and 2 asked), not the framework.

W2021455238.title: The Sensor Selection Problem for Bounded Uncertainty Sensing Models
W2021455238.venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering
W2021455238.note: Bounded-uncertainty sensor model as convex polygonal subsets of the plane; measurements merged by INTERSECTION; measurement uncertainty = AREA of the intersection; 2-approximation sensor-selection algorithm; second part relaxes to a SET of possible target locations. Structurally the closest indexed work to B problem 1 and 2.

W7125817620.title: A Set-Membership Filter for Group Target Tracking Using Bounded Bearing-Only Measurements
W7125817620.venue: 2025 17th International Conference on Signal Processing Systems (ICSPS), pp. 155-159
W7125817620.note: CONFIRMED in OpenAlex AND Crossref. Initial state, process noise and measurement noise all modelled as compact bounded sets; tracking by propagating sets containing the target state. The verbatim bounded bearing-only set-membership paper.

W2047144475.title: Ellipsoidal set filter combined set-membership and statistics uncertainties for bearing-only maneuvering target tracking
W2047144475.venue: 2014 IEEE/ION Position, Location and Navigation Symposium (PLANS), pp. 753-759
W2047144475.note: Bearing-only + set-membership + statistics, both modelled as ellipsoids of means; uses the ellipsoid GENERALIZATION RADIUS as the optimality criterion to obtain tightly outer-bounding ellipsoids. Two static platforms.

W2352577916.title: Extended Ellipsoidal Outer-Bounding Set-Membership Estimation for Nonlinear Discrete-Time Systems with Unknown-but-Bounded Disturbances
W2352577916.venue: International Journal of Distributed Sensor Networks
W2352577916.note: Generic nonlinear system, NOT bearing-only. Feasible sets guaranteed to contain more true states. Part of the Liu / Zhao / Wu line (see F1), but it is NOT the brief's A1 paper: A1 is a separate 2017 Chinese-language journal article that this run's OpenAlex and Crossref queries did not return.

W2914891741.title: A set-membership approach to find and track multiple targets using a fleet of UAVs
W2914891741.venue: 2018 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
W2914891741.note: Perturbations and measurement uncertainties described via BOUNDED SETS. Maintains sets guaranteed to contain the state of already-located targets, PLUS a set containing the states of targets still to be discovered. Control inputs chosen to minimise next-step estimation uncertainty.

W2990696718.title: Cooperative guidance of a fleet of UAVs for multi-target discovery and tracking in presence of obstacles using a set membership approach
W2990696718.note: Defines a specific criterion over the uncertainty of detected AND still-to-be-detected targets; criterion drives trajectory selection. Occlusion-aware.

W4386766665.title: Localization of Partially Hidden Moving Targets Using a Fleet of UAVs via Bounded-Error Estimation
W4386766665.note: Distributed set-membership estimator under bounded state perturbation and measurement noise; MPC over trajectories to reduce estimation uncertainty. Top-venue. Introduces a detectability set per point of the region of interest.

W3120646156.title: Target search and tracking using a fleet of UAVs in presence of decoys and obstacles
W3120646156.venue: 2020 IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC)
W3120646156.note: A priori unknown number of INDISTINGUISHABLE targets plus decoys; bounded sets; two maintained sets (localized true targets / still to be discovered) drive distributed control. Decoy handling is structurally relevant to B problem 4.

2603.04867.title: Set-Membership Localization via Range Measurements
2603.04867.note: Distance measurements with UNKNOWN-BUT-BOUNDED errors; characterizes the set of ALL points consistent with the measurements and their error model; shows it is contained in the intersection of closed balls AND A POLYTOPE, called the localization set; then computes a tight OUTER-BOUNDING set (box or ellipsoid) as a guaranteed set-valued estimate. Also poses inner approximation. Range-only, not bearing-only — but the closest indexed structural analogue of B problem 1's task.

W4402353999.title: CLOSURE: Fast Quantification of Pose Uncertainty Sets
W4402353999.note: Assumes unknown-but-bounded measurement noise; a pose uncertainty set (PURSE) contains all poses compatible with the measurements; the simplification is the minimum enclosing geodesic ball, i.e. a point estimate with MINIMUM WORST-CASE ERROR BOUND. Computes it by boundary sampling + miniball, with a certified tightness ratio against an outer approximation. SE(3) pose from keypoints, not 2D bearing.

2506.08530.title: The Invariant Zonotopic Set-Membership Filter for State Estimation on Groups
2506.08530.note: Unknown-but-bounded noise on Lie groups; F-radius optimisation for the observer gain; reports average interval area of the zonotopic estimate as a metric. Evidence that set-size scalars (F-radius, interval area) are standard set-membership performance measures.

2604.00561.title: Beyond Bounded Noise: Stochastic Set-Membership Estimation for Nonlinear Systems
2604.00561.note: Set-membership estimation when noise has UNBOUNDED support but the sample covariance is bounded; gives a finite-sample uncertainty set containing the truth with high probability. Directly relevant as a principled middle road between B problem's hard +/-1 deg bound and the purely stochastic assumption.

1612.04918.title: Exact recursive updating of uncertainty sets
1612.04918.note: Set of possible states of a linear discrete-time system under bounded disturbances and bounded measurement noise, updated EXACTLY and recursively, with two theorems describing the evolution. Directly relevant to incrementally updating the feasible polygon as detection points accumulate.

2410.18669.title: Trajectory Optimization for Unknown Maneuvering Target Tracking with Bearing-only Measurements
2410.18669.note: Surfaced by query 6 but belongs to cluster C. AUV limited to BEARING measurements; a probabilistic bearing-data-dependent bound on tracking error is rigorously established, then the OPTIMAL DESIRED BEARINGS that reduce tracking uncertainty are obtained ANALYTICALLY before trajectory optimisation. That is precisely B problem 2's question (which bearing next), solved in closed form.

2310.15846.title: Optimal Spatial-Temporal Triangulation for Bearing-Only Cooperative Motion Estimation
2310.15846.note: Surfaced by query 6 but belongs to cluster B. Same senior author as Round 1's top anchor (Shiyu Zhao). Distributed recursive least squares that fully incorporates the TRIANGULATION GEOMETRIC CONSTRAINT; exponential convergence proved. Complements B-cluster geometry results with a constructive estimator.
